20template <typename T>
21inline T diff_gamma_tilde_inv_component(const BSSNGridSoA<T> &G, size_t i, size_t j, size_t k,
22 int row, int col, int dir) {
23 const int idx = tensorium_RG::sym6_index(row, col);
24 const auto &F = G.gamma_tilde_inv[idx];
25 if (dir == 0)
26 return (T)tensorium_RG::fd::Dx(F, i, j, k, G.dx);
27 if (dir == 1)
28 return (T)tensorium_RG::fd::Dy(F, i, j, k, G.dy);
29 return (T)tensorium_RG::fd::Dz(F, i, j, k, G.dz);
30}

34// Computes ∂_j γ̃^{ij} without mutating G.tildeGamma. The Γ constraint compares
35// this diagnostic derivative against the stateful vector field stored in the
36// grid, so that violations remain observable even if Γ̃^i is evolved
37// independently.
43template <typename T>
44inline void metric_inverse_divergence(const BSSNGridSoA<T> &G, size_t i, size_t j, size_t k,
45 T out[3]) {
46 for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {
47 T sum = T(0);
48 sum += detail::diff_gamma_tilde_inv_component(G, i, j, k, a, 0, 0);
49 sum += detail::diff_gamma_tilde_inv_component(G, i, j, k, a, 1, 1);
50 sum += detail::diff_gamma_tilde_inv_component(G, i, j, k, a, 2, 2);
51 out[a] = sum;
52 }
53}

60template <typename T>
61inline void compute_contracted_gamma_from_metric(BSSNGridSoA<T> &G, size_t i, size_t j,
62 size_t k, T out[3]) {
63 metric_inverse_divergence(G, i, j, k, out);
64 out[0] = -out[0];
65 out[1] = -out[1];
66 out[2] = -out[2];
67}
